selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop dependency chain. The agent must first find a spruce_door in the environment, which serves as both a navigation/exploration task and a source of spruce planks. A spruce_door can be broken to yield spruce planks (or the agent can find spruce planks nearby as part of the scene). The spruce_sign recipe requires spruce planks and a stick. By placing spruce planks and sticks in the scene near or behind the spruce_door, the agent must first locate the door (establishing spatial awareness), then gather the materials to craft the spruce_sign. The 'find spruce_door' task naturally precedes the crafting task because the door marks the location where crafting materials are accessible, creating a logical exploration-then-craft dependency.

edges.reason: The spruce_door marks the location where spruce planks and sticks needed for crafting the spruce_sign are stored behind/near it

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce door is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5) on the south face of the cabin. The player must navigate close enough to see it and face toward it. Max distance of 8 blocks ensures the player has actually approached the building rather than just spawning nearby, and facing_tolerance of 60° confirms they are looking at the door. The player spawns ~7.07 blocks away at the origin, so they must walk toward the building.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a spruce sign places the result into the player's inventory. The player starts with 6 spruce planks and 1 stick (no spruce_sign), so this rule cannot be pre-satisfied. The recipe produces 3 spruce signs, but we only require min_count=1 since the task says 'craft to spruce_sign' (singular). This is the standard and most reliable way to verify a crafting task was completed.

A crafting table is placed just outside the front of the cabin (2 blocks south of the door) for easy access. The player spawns with 6 spruce planks and 1 stick in their inventory — the exact materials needed to craft a spruce sign.
task_text: Find the spruce door on the cabin, then use the crafting table nearby to craft a spruce sign from the materials in your inventory.
